page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top with page number 466 at left. No margin notes. Section marker "§. 3." at lower right, below the last line.

main_text.p: trodu&tionem[?] relapsos, & cum cane ad priorem vomi-tum regressos. Quis nescit illustrissimarum domuum apostasias in Bohemiâ, Poloniâ, Hungariâ, Germaniâ, Galliâ, aliisque in locis, quæ etiam multos simpliciorum animos secum in eundem pertraxerunt relapsum?

§. 2. His poculi scortationis propinatoribus operam navârunt multi Reges & Principes, iram & ardorem adjicientes, quâ quotquot lenociniis istis capi non possunt, vi externâ ad eam apostasiam cogere conantur; aut saltem relapsos, qui se deceptos serò animadvertunt, in Romanâ communione retinere laborant. Testes sunt novæ persecutionum artes in Bohemiâ, Hungariâ, & etiamnum hodiè in Galliâ: ubi admixtum Principum Regumque ardorem gustare coacti sunt, qui ad illum reditum minùs erant faciles, & etiamnum gustant, quos mollibus scriptis manum subjecisse poenitet; aut illa væsania hactenus non corripuit. Quorsum isti perverso Zeli ardore non abripiuntur? quas cogendi artes hi in gratiam meretricis Babylonicæ non invenerunt? quibus homines ad novam scortationem adigere non instituunt? ut delectentur ignominiâ eorum, qui aliàs de ipsis bene meriti & honore digni erant, dum illos haud finceram fecisse palinodiam{*} suspicantur: honoratissimos enim gradibus dejiciunt, & poenitentes ad carceres, ad remigia, imò ad lentissimas poenas rapiunt, nullâ habitâ differentiâ nobilitatis, sexûs, dignitatisve. Imò pudet æquiores & generosiores animos istius nefandæ methodi, quâ non prædicatorum sed draconum operâ delassantur Christiani, atque inauditis tormentis cruciantur, vexanturque, donec palinodiæ dictaminibus manum apponant: quod nisi fecerint ad necem usque tor-quentur.

page.notes: Running head reads "HABAKUK" with "CAP. II: 15-17." as printed; the number 466 is the page number. "trodu&tionem": the "&" is the ct ligature as printed; doubtful reading, marked [?]. Mark "{*}" after "palinodiam" is a raised asterisk-like sign with no matching note text on the page. A similar mark stands before "enim" in the line "*enim gradibus"; it is not transcribed. Mark between "adjicientes" and "quâ" is a printed reference-like sign, not transcribed. Small bullet-like marks in the left margin (around the lines "apostasias" and "pliciorum") and right margin (near "Romanâ" and "ardorem"): printer's marks, not text, not transcribed. "§. 3." at lower right is treated as a catchword, as it stands alone below the last line. Long s printed as f throughout (e.g. "relapfos", "regreffos", "fulpicantur"): transcribed as s.
